source: reliability study of the per-band refit on EDGAR filings; fit 2012-2019, test 2020-2025
model: 11 accounting level inputs plus loss and burn thresholds, fit separately within asset quintile, L2 penalty selected per stratum by 5-fold CIK-grouped cross-validation on the training window
outcome: 8-K Item 1.03 within 365 days, with the directional acquisition rule
confirmation: pre-registered on 2026 filings once their 12-month outcome windows close; supported if the paired per-quintile gain over the pooled model has a lower bound above 0.05
size_instrument: total assets (us-gaap:Assets), quintile cut points fixed on the training window

standard_universe.rule: revenue above $1M and total assets above $10M; the screen every published distress figure was measured inside
